verses.zh: 智慧建造房屋，凿成七根柱子，
verses.kjv: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.en: Wisdom has built her house and carved out its seven pillars.

verses.zh: 宰杀牲畜，调和旨酒，设摆筵席；
verses.kjv: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
verses.en: She has prepared her meat, mixed her wine, and set her table.

verses.zh: 打发使女出去，自己在城中至高处呼叫，
verses.kjv: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
verses.en: She has sent out her servant girls, and she calls from the highest places in the city:

verses.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！又对那无知的人说：
verses.kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.en: "Whoever is simple, come in here!" And to anyone with no sense she says,

verses.zh: 你们来，吃我的饼，喝我调和的酒。
verses.kjv: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.en: "Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.

verses.zh: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃愚蒙，就得存活，并要走光明的道。
verses.kjv: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.en: Leave foolish ways behind and you will live; walk on the road of understanding."

verses.zh: 指斥亵慢人的，必受辱骂；责备恶人的，必被玷污。
verses.kjv: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
verses.en: Correct someone who sneers and you will only get insulted; correct a bad person and you will get hurt.

verses.zh: 不要责备亵慢人，恐怕他恨你；要责备智慧人，他必爱你。
verses.kjv: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.en: Do not correct a person who sneers, or he will hate you. Correct a wise person, and he will love you.

verses.zh: 教导智慧人，他就越发有智慧；指示义人，他就增长学问。
verses.kjv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.en: Teach a wise person and he becomes wiser still; teach a good person and he learns even more.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端；认识至圣者便是聪明。
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD is where wisdom begins, and knowing the Holy One is understanding.

verses.zh: 你借着我，日子必增多，年岁也必加添。
verses.kjv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.en: Through me your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.

verses.zh: 你若有智慧，是与自己有益；你若亵慢，就必独自担当。
verses.kjv: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
verses.en: If you are wise, it is good for you; if you sneer at everything, you carry that by yourself.

verses.zh: 愚昧的妇人喧嚷；她是愚蒙，一无所知。
verses.kjv: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.en: A foolish woman is loud; she is simple and knows nothing at all.

verses.zh: 她坐在自己的家门口，坐在城中高处的座位上，
verses.kjv: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high part of the city,

verses.zh: 呼叫过路的，就是直行其道的人，
verses.kjv: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.en: calling out to people going past, who are going straight on their way:

verses.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！又对那无知的人说：
verses.kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.en: "Whoever is simple, come in here!" And to anyone with no sense she says,

verses.zh: 偷来的水是甜的，暗吃的饼是好的。
verses.kjv: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
verses.en: "Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret tastes good."

verses.zh: 人却不知有阴魂在她那里；她的客在阴间的深处。
verses.kjv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
verses.en: But he does not know that the dead are there, and that her guests are deep in the place of the dead.
